verdict.rationale: The evidence documents LM Studio's own `lms` CLI (chat, get, load, server start/stop), OpenAI-like endpoints, and an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint. These are building blocks a developer could point an agent at manually. Nothing shows a single command that launches third-party coding agent CLIs already configured to use local models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
